$comment: Entry schema for contributes.terminalLinks (manifest apiVersion 2, inline only). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_terminal_links.go: the pattern is a JavaScript regular expression (compiled by the frontend with the u flag, plus i when ignoreCase) of at most {{limits.patternMaxLength}} characters without backreferences, lookahead, lookbehind, named groups, inline modifiers or \p{...} escapes, and with at most 9 capturing groups; the frontend also rejects catastrophic or empty-matching patterns and disables a rule that exceeds the per-line time budget. URL targets have a fixed scheme and host; {n} capture placeholders may only appear after the first "/" following the host and are percent-encoded. File targets are allowed in local terminals only and open files inside saved Local Projects.
description: Terminal link rules: turn matching terminal output into clickable links that open a fixed-host URL or a project file.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL; {0}..{9} placeholders are allowed after the host only.

terminals.description: Terminal kinds the rule applies to; defaults to all (local only for file targets).
